title: Writer Assistant Core candidate index contract and derived index helpers
goal: Define and implement a derived candidate index layer for typed Writer Assistant Core candidate records with validation-before-indexing and path safety before extraction runtime, routes, UI, model calls, apply-promotion, or memory/canon mutation exists.
why_now: PHASE8-IMPL-003 completed candidate-only JSON write/read/list persistence helpers and intentionally deferred index read/write. The next safe slice is derived index contracts and tests before runtime extraction, routes, UI, or model behavior expand.

include: Source-of-truth boundary: candidate JSON files remain authoritative.
Candidate-only separation from OMI MVP, memory, canon, bible, storyform, scenes, notes, and materials.
exclude: Generated prose, rewriting, continuation, style imitation, or prose improvement.
Semantic search and Story Check auto-runs.
Apply-promotion, OMI candidate promotion, and memory/canon mutation.
Training data, JSONL records, dataset artifacts, and project runtime files.

index_source_of_truth_rule: writer_assistant/index.json is derived convenience metadata only; candidate JSON files remain authoritative.
acceptance_criteria: PHASE8-IMPL-004 is published as the active Writer Assistant Core parent after completed PHASE8-IMPL-003.
PHASE8-IMPL-004-T001 publishes the parent, inventory, enrichment JSON, and roadmap/status updates.
PHASE8-IMPL-004-T002 accepts the derived index contract decision and identifies T003 as the next child task.
Child tasks T001-T007 are documented with tests-first sequencing.
Scope explicitly prioritizes derived candidate index contract before extraction/runtime expansion.
Non-scope explicitly blocks extraction, routes, UI, model calls, index helpers in T001, apply-promotion, and memory/canon mutation.
Candidate JSON files remain source of truth; index is derived convenience metadata only.
No runtime code, tests, package files, backend/frontend files, project runtime files, training data, JSONL records, or dataset artifacts are changed in T001.

commands: non-LeanCTX whitespace check on changed docs
validation.notes: T002 validation is docs/decision only. Do not run pytest unless runtime code or tests were accidentally changed.

safety_notes: No generated prose, rewriting, continuation, style imitation, prose improvement, or summaries as durable truth.
Index existence does not prove story truth.
Index must not become authoritative over candidate JSON source of truth.
Candidate index supports review convenience only and does not approve or promote candidates.
OMI remains the central review and future promotion layer.
Promotion records remain audit-only until future apply-promotion exists.
Memory/canon mutation is out of scope.
Index helpers must not mutate bible, storyform, scenes, notes, materials, or approved memory/canon.
context_tools_policy: T001 and T002 do not run context tools.
PHASE8-IMPL-001 through PHASE8-IMPL-003 already provide sufficient local evidence for this parent.
Additional context tools are not needed unless a later child explicitly authorizes a narrow collect task.
Context output is evidence, not roadmap truth.
Roadmap truth remains roadmap_index.yaml, implementation_status.md, task records, enrichment JSON, and validation docs.
